literal_meaning: মাটিতে পরিণত করা (to turn into soil or dust)
similar_in_english: to go to rack and ruin
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার এই সিদ্ধান্তে পুরো পরিকল্পনাটা মাটি হয়ে গেল।
যদি তুমি এভাবে চালিয়ে যাও, সবকিছু মাটি করে দেবে।
example_sentences_in_english: His decision ruined the entire plan.
If you continue like this, you'll destroy everything.
history: Derived from the expression in Bengali literature, notably in the laghu geeti (short song) by Nishikanta, symbolizing total devastation.
note: The idiom evokes imagery of reducing something to mere earth, common in Bengali poetic and colloquial usage.
